title: Varieties of De Morgan bisemilattices
summary: De Morgan bisemilattices are expansions of distributive bisemilattices by an involution satisfying De Morgan properties. They have attracted interest both as algebraic models of analytic containment logics, and as a case study for a certain generalisation of the Płonka sum construction (De Morgan- Płonka sums). In this paper, we provide a complete description of the lattice of subvarieties of the variety DMBL of De Morgan bisemilattices.
